항목.프롬프트: Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game, one single full-bleed scene with no border and no frame: on a long dusty road leaving the walled city of Samaria behind on a hill, Israelite people walk away in a quiet line carrying bundles; in the front large and separated by small gaps: a mother in a brown dress holding her little daughter's hand with her right hand while her left arm hangs at her side, then an old man with a white beard a little apart carrying a cloth bundle on his back with both hands holding the strap at his chest, then three young men with bowed heads; nobody holds the old man's hand; tiny Assyrian soldiers with pointed helmets far away; no chains, no ropes, no hooks; dignified, grey cloudy sky. No statues, no idols, no carved figures, no winged discs, no crescent shapes, no moon ornaments, no religious symbols anywhere. Nobody is wounded, no blood, nobody lying dead. Hands are drawn simply and clearly, each hand with four fingers and a thumb, and no hand overlaps another person. Every face is clear and well drawn with distinct eyes, nose and mouth. Every person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet.
